# Pawlo – Fit My Wallpaper

> Pawlo (https://www.pawlowallpaper.com) is a web app that makes any photo fit a phone, tablet, computer or TV screen as a wallpaper without stretching, cropping or blur. It extends the photo to the screen's exact shape with AI and rebuilds it at the screen's exact resolution (HD) or up to 4K (Ultra).

- Works in the browser on iPhone, Android, iPad and computers. No app install.
- Detects the user's screen automatically; also has a list of popular phones, tablets and screens, or a custom width × height.
- Keeps the original framing: only the missing edges are filled in. Good for Pinterest photos, portrait-to-landscape, and low-resolution photos.
- Pricing: first 2 wallpapers free (Google sign-in). Basic $5 = 10 wallpapers, Pro $10 = 30, Max $20 = 100. One-time payments, no subscription, never expire.
- Photos are not stored.
